stemMd: A scale drawing uses 2 centimeters to represent 7 meters. A rectangular room is drawn 6 centimeters long and 4 centimeters wide. What is the actual area of the room, in square meters?
explanationMd: The linear scale is 3.5 meters per centimeter. The real dimensions are 21 meters and 14 meters, so area is 21×14=294 square meters. Area scales by the square of the linear factor, not by the factor once.
